rule: SPEC §11 / task rule: data-ens-place present and the four handles in menu order in header menu, home tiles, hero lead, collection filter row AND footer ([data-ens-place] order); P2 footer-group is ours and held to the same rules
defect: The four collection links in the footer «קולקציות» column carry no data-ens-place attribute. verify.js/verify-mirror.js read the order as q('[data-ens-place]') in DOM order, so the footer (the last of the five places the spec names) is invisible to the order test; the labels and order themselves are correct (path → wall → spot → decor, = the store's main-menu order confirmed via Admin API).
fix:
In footer_collections.blocks.links.settings.text add the attribute to each anchor:

תאורת שביל, עמוד וגינה

תאורת קיר

ספוטים, פרוז׳קטורים ותאורה ניידת

גרילנדות ותאורה דקורטיבית

(the footer.liquid block schema is not dumped; if the `text` setting is richtext and the editor ever re-saves it the attributes may be stripped — verify on the preview after upsert).

rule: SPEC §11 order test — the four collection names in the same order everywhere ([data-ens-place] order)
defect: The «כל המוצרים» pill carries data-ens-place="all", so on every collection page the collected [data-ens-place] sequence is ['all', path, wall, spot, decor] while the home yields [path, wall, spot, decor, path, wall, spot, decor]. verify-mirror.js filters 'all' only in headerMenuOrder, not in placeOrder, so a strict sequence comparison across pages fails on the collection template because of the fifth value.
fix: Drop data-ens-place from the «כל המוצרים» anchor (line 89): <a class="ens-ch__pill" href="{{ routes.all_products_collection_url }}"{% if ens_all %} aria-current="page"{% endif %}>… — or have verify.js filter h !== 'all' in placeOrder as it already does for the header menu.

rule: valid Liquid / HTML output — no double escaping
defect: alt is built with `| escape` (line 19) and then passed to image_tag as alt: alt (line 26); image_tag escapes attribute values itself, so any collection title or image alt containing & or quotes renders as &amp; / &quot;. The four current titles contain no such characters, so it is latent.
fix: Line 19: assign alt = img.alt | default: col.title | default: '' (remove `| escape`); keep the image_tag call unchanged.

defect: footer_about text «שאלות על מוצר או על התאמה למקום? כתבו לנו: info@elmsnest.com» and footer_bottom «ElmsNest © 2026 · תנאי משלוח וביטול» (line 285) place Latin tokens in a Hebrew line with no ; same in header-group.json line 16 note_mobile «אימייל: info@elmsnest.com».

שאלות על מוצר או על התאמה למקום? כתבו לנו: info@elmsnest.com

rule: SPEC §6.3 list mode = exactly the 4 picked products; P4 nothing of ours rendered silently
defect: When product_list is empty the section silently substitutes collections.all.products (first 4 by the /all default sort) instead of rendering nothing, so an editor who clears the list ships four arbitrary products under «מה שנדלק ראשון» with no signal; the design-mode empty state on line 51 («בחרו ארבעה מוצרים בהגדרות הסקשן.») can then never appear.
fix: Delete lines 29-31 (the `if ens_list.count == 0 or ens_list == blank … assign ens_list = collections.all.products … endif` fallback); the existing `{%- elsif request.design_mode -%}` branch already handles the empty case.

rule: P6 / SPEC §8.2.2: every Latin/number token inside a Hebrew line is <bdi dir="ltr"> (spec names IP65, LED, 10W explicitly)
defect: The <dl> values are wrapped only for en-dash ranges (elmsnest-v2-bdi-range) and for the fixed list on line 41 (IP*, LED, USB, PIR, RGB, ABS, mAh, 220V). Tokens the real bullets carry — 3000K/4000K/6000K/6500K/2700K (11 products), 6W, 12W, 120°, 90°, 360°, 15/10/6, 3/5/8, 1.5×1.5, 12×2, AA, Up/Down — stay unwrapped; the numeral caption (line 160) wraps only the IP code and ranges. Lines 210-215 also re-wrap a code that bdi-range already isolated, producing nested <bdi dir="ltr"><bdi dir="ltr">IP65</bdi></bdi> (valid but sloppy). §11 tests only en-dash ranges, so this will not fail the run, but P6 is the acceptance criterion.
fix: Replace the fixed-list loop (lines 210-215) and the caption's `replace: giant, giant_bdi` (line 160) with a word loop that isolates any token starting with a Latin letter or a digit (copy the v2-terms auto-bdi loop, elmsnest-v2-terms.liquid lines 39-55): for w in (v | split: ' ') → if w's first char is in '0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' and w does not already contain '<bdi' → wrap w in <bdi dir="ltr">…</bdi>; apply it to both the dl value and gsub_html, and drop the per-code replace so nothing is wrapped twice.

rule: SPEC §8.2.2 (facts = numeral + caption + dl + collapsed description; no heading is specified) / P2 answer-once / P4 no baked-in text of ours
defect: The section adds an h2 «מה שכדאי לדעת» (default, and set in product.elmsnest.json line 261) that §8.2.2 does not define; it echoes the description's own «פרטים שכדאי לדעת» bullets heading and the home strip's «שלושה מספרים שכדאי לדעת», and it is output unescaped ({{ heading }}, line 193; {{ more_label }}, line 228).
fix: Either set "heading": "" in templates/product.elmsnest.json (line 261) so the section renders numeral + dl + details only (the code already hides an empty heading and switches to aria-label-less section), or keep it and escape: {{ heading | escape }} / {{ more_label | escape }}. Lead's call — the spec is silent on a facts heading.
